title: Integration by parts for Jacobian minors of C² functions against a C¹ compactly supported test function (parent step (3.2)(ii))
statement: Let k, r ∈ ℕ, let V_0, …, V_r : ℝ^k → ℝ (V : Fin (r+1) → (Eucl k → ℝ)) be of class C², let b : Fin (r+1) → Fin k, and let φ : ℝ^k → ℝ be of class C¹ with compact support. With ∂_i f(x) := fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1), A(w) := (∂_{b(s)}V_t(w))_{t,s ∈ Fin (r+1)} and C_q(w) := (−1)^q det(∂_{b(q.succAbove s)}V_{t.succ}(w))_{t,s ∈ Fin r} for q ∈ Fin (r+1): ∫_{ℝ^k} φ(w)·det A(w) dw = −Σ_{q ∈ Fin (r+1)} ∫_{ℝ^k} V_0(w)·C_q(w)·∂_{b(q)}φ(w) dw, where dw is Lebesgue measure (volume).
lean_statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (V : Fin (r + 1) → Eucl k → ℝ) (b : Fin (r + 1) → Fin k) (φ : Eucl k → ℝ), (∀ t, ContDiff ℝ 2 (V t)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ w, φ w * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin (r + 1) => fderiv ℝ (V t) w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1)) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k)) = -∑ q : Fin (r + 1), ∫ w, V 0 w * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (q : ℕ) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => fderiv ℝ (V t.succ) w (EuclideanSpace.single (b (q.succAbove s)) 1))) * fderiv ℝ φ w (EuclideanSpace.single (b q) 1) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))
